title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Return Trips for the Same Fault
content:
A return trip for the same fault on the same unit inside the tier's callback window is a callback and
not a new call under the Demand Service Rate Programs.

The window is counted in calendar days from the day the original repair was completed, the completion
day excluded and the final day included, and the return call must name the original work order for the
callback to stand.

Where the tier carries free callback labor, no labor, trip charge or diagnostic fee is billed on the
callback, while parts that failed for a reason outside the original repair are billed normally.

A return trip for a different fault, or for the same fault on a different unit, is a new call at full
rates however soon it follows.

A callback does not consume an emergency call from the allowance and does not draw block hours.

| The return trip | Treatment |
|---|---|
| same fault, same unit, inside the window, naming the original work order | a callback |
| same fault, same unit, inside the window, naming no original work order | not a callback |
| same fault, different unit | a new call at full rates |
| different fault, same unit | a new call at full rates |
| same fault, same unit, past the window | a new call at full rates |

**Both sides of the window (hypothetical).** On a program whose callback window is 45 calendar days,
with the original repair completed on a boundary day, a return trip on the 45th day after that day is
inside the window, the completion day being excluded and the final day included; a return trip on the
46th day is outside it and is a new call at full rates.
